answer: Admission proof-of-work at the gate: each identity submits a puzzle costing 500 CPU-hours, verified before minting. A plume of parallel farms scales linearly, but the karst of fixed puzzle difficulty erodes margins — renting 1000 identities costs ~$12k at $12/GPU-hour. A whisper of collusion gains nothing since puzzles are non-outsourceable without cost. Attacker break-even never arrives; honest single agents pay once. Works because cost scales linearly with identity count while reward stays flat.
